results.title: Patlabor EZY File 2
results.original_title: 機動警察パトレイバー EZY　File 2
results.overview: Patlabor EZY: File 2 is the second of a 3-part theatrical series taking place in 2036, 38 years after the events of Patlabor on Television and The New Files. Set in the TV continuity, this new production does not take place in the same timeline as the Patlabor film series or live-action drama.

results.title: The Twin Who Lived
results.overview: After discovering she once had a twin sister who died when she was a child, Claire begins receiving strange gifts signed with her sister's name. What at first seems like a cruel prank soon escalates into disturbing signs that someone is breaking into her home and trying to take control of Claire's life.

results.title: Unplug
results.overview: When a mysterious Orb is discovered, a group of high schoolers are forced to face both strained relationships and past actions in an effort to combat the deceitful temptation of misconstrued justice that resides within...

results.title: My Face
results.overview: A young, ambitious director travels to the frontlines of Ukraine to shoot a gritty war film. There, he clashes with a local military priest whose quiet faith stands in stark contrast to his own cynicism. When the chaplain dies saving his life, the director returns home transformed, determined to help the widow and child of the fallen. Desperate for funding, he strikes a deal with a masked, anonymous film blogger known only as The Mask. The condition is simple but unsettling: he must direct under a false name and never show his face. But behind the arrangement lies an old grudge and a long buried thirst for revenge from someone in his past. As the film's premiere nears, the director is drawn into a dangerous game where identity, vengeance, and redemption collide.

results.title: Perfect Princess
results.overview: Reluctantly donning princess regalia and delivering cupcakes, Chad stumbles through an ill-fated day - only to discover that leaving with nothing might be pretty sweet.

results.title: Mordgåtan i paradiset – svenskarna som försvann
results.original_title: Mordgåtan i paradiset – svenskarna som försvann
results.overview: Swedish tourists Urban and Heidi disappeared in New Zealand in 1989. Now, the conviction of the man identified as their killer has been overturned, and the mystery remains unsolved.

results.title: Demonic Plastic Surgery
results.overview: When beauty becomes an obsession. To save her lover, Thanh accepts a job at a remote beauty clinic. However, the living nightmare of macabre rituals, wandering ghosts, and a terrifying secret lays behind the clinic. Drawn into the "Đi Thiếp" ritual, Thanh is forced to make a choice: to remain in the underworld by her lover’s side, or fight to escape the clutches of the dark forces.

results.title: Seven Years and Seven Days: The Story of Jacob and Rachel
results.original_title: Seven Years and Seven Days: The Story of Jacob and Rachel
results.overview: As the story of Jacob and Rachel's lives unfold, God reveals His grand and sovereign plan to bring about the beginning of His divine promise for the future of Israel through their romance.

results.title: Stella by Starlight
results.overview: On Stella’s 29th birthday, four days before her band is set to embark on a career-altering tour, she learns that it is canceled. As she scrambles to salvage the tour and rally her bandmates, tensions rise, threatening not just the tour but the band's future.

results.title: The Frog and the Water
results.overview: The cautious friendship between Stefan Busch, known to everyone as Buschi, and Mr. Hideo Kitamura begins on this special road trip. Buschi, who has refused to speak with his fellow human beings his entire life, blossoms on this journey to unknown places.

results.title: What I'd Do for Love
results.overview: Greer Patterson's happy marriage falls apart when she discovers her husband's infidelity. After exacting bitter revenge, she's back on the market looking for love, and anyone standing in her way will see just how far she'll go. Based on the novel by K. F. Johnson.

results.title: Far End of the Sea
results.overview: Washed ashore on a small island in the Pacific, shipwrecked Scottish sailor, Hamish MacKay, is quickly taken captive by local islander Adiben. On route back to Adiben’s village where an ill fate certainly awaits him, Hamish must figure out a way to escape his captor. At the same time, Adiben must make an impossible choice: to fulfil his responsibility to his people or to help a stranger lost at the far end of the sea.

results.title: Yaarra Antha Paiyan Naanthan Antha Paiyan
results.original_title: யார்ரா அந்த பையன் நான் தா அந்த பையன்
results.overview: Vijay and Shalini’s marriage is crumbling under constant misunderstandings. In the same city, Deepika loses her alcoholic husband Manikandan and is left drowning in loneliness.  Seeking comfort, Deepika and Vijay cross the line and fall into a secret affair.But danger strikes when Sukumar, a corrupt sub-inspector obsessed with Deepika, begins  hunting her for his own desires. As guilt closes in on Vijay and suspicion rises for Shalini, Deepika is trapped between a forbidden relationship and a ruthless predator.  Will Shalini discover the truth? And can Deepika escape Sukumar’s grip before everything collapses?

results.title: Sexo e Destino
results.overview: Between two families marked by betrayal and obsession, the Nogueiras and the Torres, forces from the spiritual realm work to lead each member to a reckoning with their own destiny.

results.title: Nos cœurs sur la main
results.overview: A meeting of media, director, and artist, Nos coeurs sur la main is a musical adventure following Ino Casablanca. The project captures a day-long performance blurring the lines between music and fiction, retracing the live recording of a discography in perpetual motion, all within a race against time orchestrated by a peculiar producer, Franck. Across over an hour of music, director Toxine fictionalizes Ino Casablanca's repertoire while upholding the rapper's core values: playing from the heart, unity, and sharing. It serves as a powerful reminder that every musical journey is, at its core, a collective one.

results.title: Red Forest
results.overview: A poetic David and Goliath tale, where David is an eco-activist with shields, helmets and Molotov cocktails in the backpack. Director Laurie Lassalle documents the spirit and atmosphere with loyalty and an extraordinarily confident cinematic vision.

results.title: Touch Grass
results.overview: An offbeat short about a defiant girl in a sticky situation. After a violent attack and a perfectly rolled spliff, she wreaks havoc against God in the confines of her musty room.

results.title: Dreaming Serenada
results.overview: Danish-Ugandan Luba returns to her father’s rainforest in Uganda to save what is on the brink of being lost – a personal story about climate struggle, belonging, and Denmark’s responsibility in a changing world.
